optimization_policy.note: Do not lower reasoning effort/context/output budget to improve timing. Freeze validated serving settings for each clean attempt.
optimization_policy.probe_definition: Median of two warm single-request 256-output-token probes after one cold probe; same fixed 3473-token GLM prompt (token counts vary by tokenizer). Decode rate excludes time to first token.
optimization_policy.on_failure: Preserve evidence; annotate throughput infrastructure skip, never model-quality failure; continue next model.
optimization_policy.threshold_note: User raised provisional threshold from 50 to 100 tok/s on 2026-10-17. Admission uses two warm fixed single-request measurements; their median equals their arithmetic mean. Report sustained benchmark decode separately.
optimization_policy.official_model_card_review: Always inspect the official Hugging Face model card, even when the first throughput probe is >=100 tok/s. Record applicable inexpensive serving recommendations and adopted or deferred settings. Below 100 tok/s, do additional research and bounded optimization tests. Stop tuning once >=100 tok/s and the mandatory card review/tool checks are complete; maximum three configurations and 45 minutes remain.

pause_policy.cutoffs: Pause pending post-batch review; retain workspace, generated code, temporary execution files, sessions, grading and injection state, logs and configuration. DNF is queue control, not final abandonment.
pause_policy.checkpoint: Write PAUSED, RESUME.md and timestamped pause-checkpoints/state.json at each cutoff; export available OpenCode sessions.
pause_policy.weights_exception: May remove downloaded model weights when space is needed after recording exact Hugging Face repository and immutable revision. Preserve all other resumable execution state.
pause_policy.gpu: Archive logs and launch metadata before stopping owned inference process; GPU KV cache can be rebuilt.

watchdog_deployment.verification: remote PID alive; runpodctl stop pod syntax available; local 22-test suite passed; real shutdown not triggered on active pod
